newsitem.title: PERU: Telefonica del Peru sells 93 mln soles in bonds.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica del Peru sells 93 mln soles in bonds.

text.p: Telefonica del Peru has sold 93 million soles ($35.1 milllion) of one-year debt paper in an ongoing issue where the firm offered a total of 100 million soles, the Lima bolsa said Tuesday.
Investors can continue to buy the remaining seven million soles worth of debt offered by the country's top telecom, according to the stock exchange.
The auction, which started Monday, is Telefonica's second issue in a global sale of corporate bonds through which the firm aims to raise $400 million by 1999.
In the first issue last year, the company, which is controlled by Telefonica de Espana, sold 250 million soles worth of corporate bonds.
In a separate ongoing global issue to raise $180 million, Telefonica has sold about $110 million worth of short-term debt.
